name: ontology-forge
description: Design and extend a Palantir Foundry ontology the domain-driven way: interview the domain, shape object types, links, interfaces and actions, then map source data and logic onto them.

interface.shortDescription: Design a Foundry ontology, domain first
interface.longDescription: Work through the three stages of ontology design — understand the domain, design the object model, map source data and logic — with Palantir's best practices, structural guidance, and anti-pattern catalog applied at every step.
defaultPrompt: Design an ontology for this domain
Extend the ontology with a new requirement
